brief:
Israeli occupation forces fired on a shepherd in the West Bank, killing three of his sheep, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incident marked another confrontation between Palestinians and Israeli military personnel in the territory, where such clashes have become routine.

Shepherding remains a primary livelihood for many Palestinians in remote areas of the West Bank. Herders frequently encounter Israeli forces while moving their livestock across grazing lands, leading to periodic confrontations and property losses that affect Palestinian communities dependent on pastoral farming.
title: Israeli forces shoot shepherd, kill three sheep in West Bank
